name: EnvelopeShapes.InvalidJsonBody
why: 503 body is truncated JSON containing all triple tokens; an unparseable body can never satisfy the exact-triple rule.

name: EnvelopeShapes.TopLevelArray
why: Exact triple present but the top-level JSON value is an array, not an object; fails the JSON-object requirement.

name: EnvelopeShapes.ErrorAsString
why: error is the string 'Loading model', not an object; the triple fields cannot be read so the rule does not fire.

name: EnvelopeShapes.MissingCode
why: error object has exact message and type but no integer code field; all three members are required.

name: EnvelopeShapes.CodeAsString
why: code is the string '503', not integer 503; the rule demands an exact integer so this stays FOREIGN_SERVICE.

name: EnvelopeShapes.ExtraFieldsAllowed
why: Exact error triple with extra top-level siblings; the rule inspects error only, extra fields are allowed -> MODEL_LOADING.

name: EnvelopeShapes.NestedEnvelope
why: Exact triple inside error nested one level deeper under 'outer'; top-level error object is absent -> no match.

name: EnvelopeShapes.Padding64KiB
why: Exact triple plus a 64 KiB extra padding field; size and extras must not defeat detection -> MODEL_LOADING.

name: EnvelopeShapes.BomPrefixedJson
why: UTF-8 BOM precedes an otherwise exact-triple body; strict JSON parsing rejects a leading BOM -> stays FOREIGN_SERVICE.
